signal.causality: Only daily candles whose close_time is strictly before decision_time are eligible.
signal.score: 28-day simple return divided by sample standard deviation of the same 28 daily log returns
signal.selection: Long highest score, short lowest score; deterministic symbol order breaks exact ties.
signal.while_open: Ignore later weekly rankings until the pair closes; after a close wait until the next Monday decision.

beta_neutral_weights.weights: long gross weight = short beta/(long beta+short beta); short gross weight = long beta/(long beta+short beta)
beta_neutral_weights.invalid_action: Skip the entry; never clip a weight because clipping would break beta neutrality.

risk.pair_volatility: Sample standard deviation of long minus short daily log returns over the same 28 completed returns.
risk.gross_notional: min(0.75 * current equity, risk budget / stop distance)
risk.pair_hard_stop: Close-confirmed net liquidation PnL <= -1R; exit both legs at next 5m open.
risk.pair_take_profit: Close-confirmed net liquidation PnL >= +2R; exit both legs at next 5m open.
risk.same_bar_precedence: STOP before TARGET (relevant only to synthetic/unit fixtures); production triggers use one pair close mark.
risk.maximum_hold: 28 calendar days; exit both legs at the first 5m open at or after the deadline.
risk.leverage: 1x gross notional against a shared cash ledger
risk.drawdown_halt: Do not open new pairs after a 6% peak-to-marked-equity drawdown; no automatic restart inside a window.

execution.entry: First aligned 5m open at the Monday decision time.
execution.exit: Both legs at the same aligned 5m open after a close-confirmed pair trigger, or at the max-hold/end boundary.
execution.funding: For each actual settlement strictly after entry and up to exit, long pays positive rate and short receives positive rate, using the aligned 5m open as mark proxy.

ledger: One shared cash balance; both legs form one indivisible pair episode. No summing of standalone-symbol accounts.

gates.development: At least 4 closed pair episodes, net PnL > 0, episode profit factor > 1.05 in base, and net PnL > 0 under stress.
gates.validation: Run only if development passes; at least 2 episodes, base net PnL > 0 and PF > 1.10, stress net PnL >= 0 and PF >= 1.00.
gates.promotion: Even if historical gates pass: paper-forward only for at least 26 weekly decisions and 12 closed episodes; live remains disabled.

disclosures: The universe has only three tradable assets, so cross-sectional breadth and episode count are intrinsically small.
Futures open is used as the funding mark proxy; exchange-specific mark price, liquidation engine, outages, latency and taxes are not modelled.

The 2025-2026 evaluation months were inspected in earlier strategy research and are not an untouched holdout; the 2024 validation is chronologically later than development but not claimed as pristine without an audit of all prior work.
No parameter grid or post-result retuning is permitted in this run.
supersession_reason: Methodology correction before any market-data load or result was observed: SOLUSDT's public daily and 5-minute archives are both missing 2022-02-26..02-28 and 2022-04-01..04-02 (ETHUSDT and BNBUSDT checked gap-free across the full range). simulate_xsm_pairs' execution-continuity check has no gap-tolerance option by design, so the development window start moves from 2021-04-05 to 2022-04-04 (the next Monday after the gap) rather than patching or interpolating missing candles. See protocol_history.json for the full chain, including the prior 14-month-to-5-year sample-size correction.
